mapper.select: select distinct activity.id, '主舞台・' || activity."name" as note, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE("session"."date", 'YYYY/MM/DD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "value", TO_CHAR(TO_DATE("session"."date", 'YYYY/MM/DD'), 'FMMM"月"FMDD"日"') || ' (' || CASE EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM TO_DATE("session"."date", 'YYYY/MM/DD')) WHEN 1 THEN '一' WHEN 2 THEN '二' WHEN 3 THEN '三' WHEN 4 THEN '四' WHEN 5 THEN '五' WHEN 6 THEN '六' WHEN 7 THEN '日' end || ') ' AS "label" FROM "interviewworks_ticket"."activity" activity INNER JOIN "interviewworks_ticket"."session" "session" ON activity."name" = "session".activity where activity."name" = #{activityName} ORDER BY activity.id

select "session".id, "session"."time" as "value", "session"."time" || ' ' || CASE WHEN "session"."time"::time BETWEEN '06:00'::time AND '11:59:59'::time THEN '早晨場' WHEN "session"."time"::time BETWEEN '12:00'::time AND '17:59:59'::time THEN '午後場' ELSE '星空場' END AS "label", "session".capacity as available FROM "interviewworks_ticket"."session" "session" where "session"."date" = #{date} ORDER BY "session"."date"
select activity.id, activity.price FROM "interviewworks_ticket"."activity" activity where activity.id = #{activityId}
mapper.insert: insert into "interviewworks_ticket"."user_data" (name, email, phone, password, birthday, permissions) values ( #{name}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{password}, '', '' )

INSERT INTO "interviewworks_ticket".ticket ( orderno, customer, email, "name", "date", "time", status, price ) VALUES ( #{orderno}, #{customer}, #{email}, #{name}, #{date}, #{time}, #{status}, #{price} ) ON CONFLICT (orderno) DO UPDATE SET customer = EXCLUDED.customer, email = EXCLUDED.email, "name" = EXCLUDED."name", "date" = EXCLUDED."date", "time" = EXCLUDED."time", status = EXCLUDED.status, price = EXCLUDED.price
mapper.select: select ticket.orderno, ticket."name", ticket."date", ticket."time", CASE WHEN ticket."time"::time BETWEEN '06:00'::time AND '11:59:59'::time THEN '早晨場' WHEN ticket."time"::time BETWEEN '12:00'::time AND '17:59:59'::time THEN '午後場' ELSE '星空場' END AS timename, ticket.status FROM "interviewworks_ticket".ticket ticket WHERE ticket.customer = #{customer} ORDER BY ticket.created_date, ticket.updated_date

select distinct "session".activity, "session"."date", "session"."time", "session".salesdate, "session".salestime from "interviewworks_ticket"."session" "session" where "session".activity = #{activity} and "session"."date" = #{date} and "session"."time" = #{time} order by "session"."date" desc
